description: This file implements a parser for the Linux /dev/kmsg format, providing functionality to read, parse, and handle kernel message logs, including managing boot time and message metadata.

classes.name: parser
classes.description: Unexported struct implementing the Parser interface, managing reading from /dev/kmsg, parsing messages, and maintaining boot time.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Sets the logger used for reporting errors and warnings.

methods.name: SeekEnd
methods.description: Moves the parser to the end of the kmsg queue.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Returns a channel that emits parsed kernel messages, reading asynchronously from /dev/kmsg.

methods.name: parseMessage
methods.description: Parses a raw message string into a Message struct, extracting priority, sequence number, timestamp, and message content.
